name: Lactation consultant support
summary: How new parents in Singapore find lactation consultants — IBCLC vs hospital nurses, tongue-tie referrals, pump flange fitting, and home-visit norms after discharge.
body:
Lactation consultants help with latch, supply, pump routines, and return-to-work feeding plans. Hospital postpartum nurses cover basics; complex pain, mastitis risk, or exclusive pumping often needs a dedicated IBCLC session.

## Common reasons to book
- Painful latch or nipple trauma after birth
- Low supply worries vs normal cluster feeding
- Flange sizing and pump hire setups
- Tongue-tie assessment pathways
- Mixed feeding plans before EP/DP work resumes

Clarify whether the visit is clinical advice only or includes weighing and feeding observation.

## How to choose
Prefer credentialed IBCLC (or equivalent) over generic “breastfeeding coach” titles. Ask about home-visit radius and after-hours WhatsApp boundaries. Coordinate with your paediatrician rather than stacking conflicting advice. Insurance rarely covers private lactation — budget cash rates.

## Practical tip
Book before discharge if hospital feeds are already stressful. Have a recent wet/dirty diaper log ready — it shortens the history-taking and gets you to hands-on help faster.
